title: Mirabel and the Asset
author: Orsen Vasquez
blurb: Tamsin Iversen, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
